prompt: Build comments for blog posts: people can post a comment and read comments under each post. It's a Next.js app with Drizzle and Postgres.
assertions: Writes the contract before building: a states list per screen, the API shapes with error codes, and the hook signatures
Every error code maps to a UI state and every UI state names the API signal that triggers it
Splits the work between the ui-designer agent (screens, states, copy) and a developer agent (migration, API, client hooks), with a written file list per agent and one owner per shared file
The migration is additive, has a length CHECK and NOT NULL constraints, and indexes (post_id, created_at, id) for keyset pagination
The list endpoint uses cursor pagination with a clamped page size; posting accepts an idempotency key or is otherwise safe to retry
The final report contains both gates (kwx-developer and kwx-designer) and the duet rows J1 to J9, with no open critical row
